name: ios-swift-testflight
summary: SwiftUI iOS app built with xcodebuild, shipped to TestFlight from GitHub Actions with an App Store Connect API key.
skill_rows: | `/app-audit` | entitlement drift, privacy strings, ATS, money-as-Double, background registration, then the app reviewer | a verdict |
| `/release-ios` | runbook for the TestFlight upload a push to main sets in motion, and the one-time App Store Connect setup | confirmation the build reached the phone |
one_time_steps: App Store Connect: create an API key (Users and Access → Integrations → App Store Connect API) with App Manager access; store its .p8 as the ASC_PRIVATE_KEY repo secret, plus ASC_KEY_ID and ASC_ISSUER_ID; store the 10-character team id as APPLE_TEAM_ID (the archive step refuses to run without it).
Register the bundle id and create the app record in App Store Connect; add yourself as an internal TestFlight tester.
Fill ios/Config/ExportOptions.plist with the team id, and set {{APP}} to the real scheme name in docs/context.md gates and the workflows.
